objective.name: continuity.project
objective.description: Builds a deterministic bounded view of a continuity and any explicitly requested related continuities without altering durable cognitive history.

#root.role: Transform complete durable continuity history into a deterministic non-cognitive projection suitable for contextual consumption.

default_projection._comment: Optional. Default projection of the pilot, supplied by the caller as a value (transit): composed by mode merge, ignored by mode replace. When absent, merge composes the request with an empty default. continuity.project never reads pilot_definition.

transformation_contract.morphing: A complete continuity history and deterministic projection definition become a bounded reproducible contextual view.
invariants: continuity.project never mutates the continuity header, journal, mailbox or runtime Matters, and never reads pilot_definition.
The journal remains the source of truth.
The pinned lines (kind framework, the cognitive frame) are always carried first by a projection, whatever its filters, limit or budget; the budget never counts them.
Projection is deterministic for the same source state, definition, mode, and budget.
Projection performs no LLM inference.
Projection performs no cognitive summarization.
Projection never reformulates message meaning.
Projection never decides importance through semantic reasoning.
Canonical relative message order follows message.seq.
Parent and child continuities are not included unless explicitly requested.
A dynamic projection never modifies the default projection supplied by the caller.

By default the projection takes the whole continuity, the thread of the LLM: the lines of kind user, pilot, capacity_intention, capacity_response, continuity, summary, prompt and completion. The follow-up kinds (event, projection, error, control) stay in the journal and are not part of it unless the projection asks for them explicitly through include_kinds, in which case they are read from the journal.
success: The effective projection definition is resolved from mode, default projection, and requested projection.
Only explicitly eligible messages are selected.
The selected view is deterministically reduced when required by budget.
selected_message_ids identifies the durable source messages represented by the result.
A projection selecting no messages is a valid result.
failure: Fails if the bound continuity does not correspond to continuity_id.
Fails if projection or mode is structurally invalid.
Fails if an explicitly referenced related continuity cannot be resolved.
Does not alter any Matter when projection fails.
notes: Executed by the agentic_core Python wrapper.
Filtering, ordering, selection, and budget reduction are computation local to this interpreted capacity.
The DSL is not used to reshape or filter message collections because such data transformation belongs in wrapper-backed computation.
Related-continuity retrieval, when required, must use an explicit Brique capacity call rather than hidden direct access to another Matter.

Implementation constraint: the continuity is managed in a Matter (the journal) for persistence and duplicated in an in-memory object of the wrapper for performance. The projection reads that object, rebuilt from the journal when absent or stale, and applies its criteria on it; the size of each line is computed once when it enters the object.

#resolve_state.role: Derive the continuity header Matter and the journal Matter owned by the target continuity from continuity_id.

failure: Fails if the derived continuity header or journal Matter does not exist.
invariants: The Matter IDs follow the convention continuity_<id> (header) and journal_<id>.
Resolution is deterministic and requires no caller-provided Matter.
transformation_contract.morphing: A continuity_id becomes the physical Matter IDs continuity_<id> and journal_<id> of its continuity.

default_projection._comment: Optional. Default projection supplied by the caller as a value; absent means an empty default.

#default_mode.role: Treat an absent mode as merge.

transformation_contract.morphing: An unspecified projection mode becomes merge.

#replace.role: Use the requested projection as the effective temporary definition.

transformation_contract.morphing: A requested projection becomes the complete effective temporary projection.

default_projection._comment: Optional. Default projection supplied by the caller as a value; absent means an empty default.

#merge.role: Compose the requested projection with the supplied default projection using deterministic composition rules.

invariants: Composition follows explicit projection-field semantics rather than cognitive interpretation.
transformation_contract.morphing: A default projection and requested projection become one deterministic composed projection.

#resolve_definition.role: Build the effective deterministic projection definition from the requested projection and the optional default projection supplied by the caller.

invariants: mode accepts merge or replace.
merge combines the requested definition with the supplied default_projection.
replace ignores default_projection for this projection only.
No Matter is read or modified: the default projection is a value supplied by the caller.
transformation_contract.morphing: A requested projection mode and an optional default projection become one effective deterministic projection definition.

#local.role: Use the bound continuity journal as the primary projection source, read by line range when the projection does not need all of it.

transformation_contract.morphing: The bound continuity journal becomes the primary ordered source message stream.

#related.role: Read explicitly requested related continuities through the engine-native matter.read capacity.

invariants: Cross-Matter retrieval is explicit.
Only continuity ids requested by the effective projection are read.

related_matter_ids are Matter ids derived by the wrapper from the requested continuity ids through the convention continuity_<continuity_id>, then journal_ref for their journal; the DSL does not compose identifiers.
transformation_contract.morphing: Explicit related Matter ids, derived from requested continuity ids, become readable related continuity states.

#collect_sources.role: Resolve the local continuity history and any additional continuities explicitly requested by the effective projection.

invariants: The local continuity is always the primary source.
No parent or child history is included implicitly.
Only explicitly requested related continuities may be added.
transformation_contract.morphing: A local continuity and explicit related-continuity selectors become the complete authorized source set for projection.

#filter.role: Apply all explicit inclusion and exclusion constraints.

transformation_contract.morphing: Source messages become the subset satisfying explicit deterministic projection predicates.

#order.role: Preserve canonical message ordering across the selected source set.

invariants: Within each continuity, seq defines canonical order.
Any cross-continuity ordering rule must be deterministic and explicit.
transformation_contract.morphing: A filtered message set becomes a canonically ordered projected stream.

#select.role: Apply deterministic all, first, last, explicit-id, and limit selection rules.

transformation_contract.morphing: A filtered ordered stream becomes the exact message subset requested by the projection definition.

#select_messages.role: Apply deterministic projection filters and selectors to the authorized source message streams.

invariants: Selection may use explicit kind, origin, destination, seq, correlation, message-id, continuity, and deterministic first/last/all criteria.
Filtering performs no semantic interpretation of content.
The relative canonical order of selected messages is preserved.
transformation_contract.morphing: Authorized source messages become the deterministic subset selected by projection rules.

#measure.role: Measure the representation cost of the current projected view under the configured budget convention.

transformation_contract.morphing: A projected message set becomes an explicit deterministic context cost.

#reduce.role: Apply deterministic projection reduction rules until the view fits the allowed budget.

invariants: Reduction remains non-cognitive.
No LLM is invoked.
transformation_contract.morphing: An oversized projected message set becomes a budget-conforming structural subset.

#fit_budget.role: Reduce the selected projection deterministically when its representation exceeds the allowed budget.

invariants: Budget reduction removes or narrows structural selections rather than cognitively summarizing content.
Message text is not blindly truncated mid-content.
The same input and budget produce the same reduced result.
transformation_contract.morphing: A selected projection exceeding its budget becomes a smaller deterministic projection that fits its allowed context space.
success: The result fits the effective budget or is empty when no admissible deterministic reduction can retain a message.

#materialize_view.role: Assemble the selected durable messages into the final projection payload without creating new durable state.

invariants: The resulting projection is transient.
No projection Matter is created.
No durable message is altered.
transformation_contract.morphing: A deterministic selected message set becomes the final transient continuity projection.
